_note: alpha's declaration. A fixture, authored so every field record-index requires has a site and so the counts a hand derivation predicts are small enough to check. Where a value differs from the second fixture repo (beta), the difference is the point: conventions are DECLARED, and a tool that only worked on this shape would be reading one repo's habits as a law.

corpora._prose_files: docs/absent-by-declaration.md is DELIBERATELY ABSENT. A declared corpus that is not on disk is a reported finding, never a raise — three parsers used to raise FileNotFoundError on a file list belonging to a different repo, and this fixture keeps that path exercised.

discovery._ruling_arc: STEM-DERIVED, and load-bearing in this fixture specifically: E02-ruling.md and E02-offsurface-ruling.md both number their rulings from one. Stem-derived they are two arcs; keyed on the leading E-number they are one arc and collide on two primary keys.

vocabularies._verdicts: Deliberately SHORT. CORRECTED, BANKED and MEASURED are shouted in this record and are absent from this list, so the verdict counter has three real misses to name. A vocabulary that recognised everything would be a counter that reads the same when it works and when it does nothing.
vocabularies._artifact_kinds: mp4 is in artifact_extensions and NOT in this map, on purpose. That is the exact silent drop this package's vocabulary counters were built for: six video mentions vanished from a record whose product is video, and an empty table looked the same as a table that had discarded them.
phenomenon_markers: is BANKED as a measured phenomenon

_laws: The attribution pattern covers E01 and E02 only, while one law's body mentions E03 alone. That law's paid_for_by is null and the counter names E03 — which is the shape of the defect measured on a real record, where half a law book carried a null attribution silently.

sweep._current_state_dirs: MEASURED, and it is a constraint rather than a choice: `sweep.current_state_dirs` is not in the package's MAY_BE_EMPTY set, so a repo with no current-state directory cannot declare that it has none — the loader refuses the empty list. alpha therefore has a real one.
sweep._self_reference_exclude: E02-report.md quotes a count as data. Without the exclusion the sweep would flag its own subject matter; with it, the whole file is skipped.
sweep._claim_families: Four families, and DELIBERATELY not one for experiments-as-a-cardinal: `3 experiments` is count-claim-shaped, no family parses it, and it must surface as unparseable rather than be guessed at.

verify._count_checks: The verifier's OWN greps, written against the file rather than reusing the parser's patterns, so the two are not one implementation checking itself.
verify._seeded: Every phrase here was run report-only through `q` BEFORE it entered the gate, and its target ranked within the top 3 on that run. Seeds are ruled in from measured ranks; a seed added and then tuned until green is a check that cannot fail.
